resources.string: Local settings are saved, but Hook synchronization failed. Root-only operation remains available. Remote authorization may still contain the previous value; retry synchronization. The new Hook must be loaded for the unified gate.

Hook synchronization is unavailable or pending. Local settings are retained and Root-only operation remains available; this is not remote confirmation. Retry when the framework is connected. The new Hook must be loaded.
Hook settings committed and read back through the framework. This does not confirm that a newly updated Hook has been loaded.
This action did not finish. Check the saved settings and retry. Hook synchronization is reported separately; no remote success is assumed.
